description: Costco Same-Day (sameday.costco.com) GraphQL CLI. Cookie auth after Costco Azure B2C SSO.

novel_features.name: Dual-gated place order
novel_features.description: Charge via FinalizeCheckout only when both --yes and --confirm-charge are set; --dry-run never POSTs the charge mutation.

novel_features.name: Checkout preview without charge
novel_features.description: Read-only CheckoutDraftOrderInvoiceV2 / CheckoutCmd totals; never calls FinalizeCheckout.

novel_features.name: Tip update via UpdateCheckout
novel_features.description: Mutate tip with UpdateCheckout tipsUpdate (requires --yes); --dry-run safe; never charges.

novel_features.name: Gated REST order cancel
novel_features.description: Cancel via PUT /api/v2/orders/{orderId}/cancel?source=web; requires --yes; --dry-run never sends. Not a GraphQL mutation.
